$comment: Caps for files that load into agent context every session or get re-read whole. First matching glob wins. A project can add or override rules in .claude/budgets.json (checked first, same shape); set "off": true on a rule to disable it there.

rules.why: It loads into every session of every project on this machine.
rules.fix: Keep only rules that apply to all projects. Move project-specific lines to that project's CLAUDE.md and procedures to a skill.

rules.why: It loads into every Codex session in every repository.
rules.fix: Keep only cross-repository rules; move the rest into the repository's own AGENTS.md.

rules.why: A handoff is a snapshot of now, read at the start of the next session. Handoffs that get appended to every session are how they reach thousands of lines.
rules.fix: Overwrite it as a snapshot: goal, state, next steps, gotchas, verify command. Delete finished items (they live in git commits), move durable decisions to docs/decisions/ and every-session rules to CLAUDE.md.

rules.why: A rule is injected into context whenever Claude reads a file it matches.
rules.fix: One topic per rule file and one line per rule. Move rationale and history to docs/.

rules.why: It loads into every session in this project. Anthropic's guidance is under 200 lines, because longer files consume more context and reduce adherence.
rules.fix: Run /claude-md-audit. Keep the rules that prevent real mistakes; move procedures to skills, area-specific rules to .claude/rules/ with paths:, rationale and history to docs/.

rules.why: It loads into every session in this project, alongside CLAUDE.md.
rules.fix: Keep personal, machine-specific notes only; anything the team needs belongs in CLAUDE.md.

rules.why: It loads into every Codex session here, and into Claude sessions that import it. OpenAI's own tips for stretching Codex limits include shrinking AGENTS.md.
rules.fix: Run /claude-md-audit on it. Keep build/test commands, non-standard conventions and gotchas; drop overviews the code already shows.

rules.why: Anthropic: keep SKILL.md under 500 lines. After compaction only the first 5,000 tokens of an invoked skill are re-injected.
rules.fix: Move reference material into separate files next to SKILL.md and link to them.

rules.why: Agents usually read a doc whole, so a 600-line doc costs about 8K tokens every time any part of it is needed.
rules.fix: Split it by topic into smaller files with a one-line index entry each. Archive finished plans and audits instead of extending them.
